title: Mexico City
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Yellow Mexico City Player card, 19°25'57"N 99°7'60"W. One covered SEARCH box. Not a port. This is Mexico City's only Player card. Code P1-15b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: While this card is in your hand, as an action you may discard a City card, including this card, to draw a City card of the same color from the Player discard pile.

states.summary: Companion: Scout. As an action, discard a City card (including this card) to draw a City card of the same color from the Player discard pile, if you have this card in your hand.

rules: Yellow Player card for Mexico City. One land search box, labeled SEARCH. No anchor.
The scratch reveals the Scout companion.
While the card is in your hand, you may spend an action to discard a City card and draw a City card of the same color from the Player discard pile.
The discarded City card may be this card.
The power lasts for later games while the card is held. Discarding this card spends the companion.
This is Mexico City's only Player card. It goes to the reserve until the city joins the grid.
notes: Card id 912. Scratched face card id 1007. Printed code P1-15b.
